of.needed: whether the ingress-nginx strict-validate-path-type configuration option is enabled

consequence.statement: With ingress-nginx strict-validate-path-type enabled (the default in ingress-nginx >= 1.12.0), the validate.nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io admission webhook rejects the HTTP01 challenge Ingress because its path contains a dot. The controller then logs 'Error presenting challenge: admission webhook ... denied the request', and the HTTP01 challenge cannot be solved.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 creates ACME HTTP01 challenge Ingress routes with PathType Exact. ingress-nginx's strict-validate-path-type option (available from 1.8.0 and on by default from 1.12.0) rejects these routes, so presenting the challenge fails with an admission webhook denial.
